issue_request: FHIR-6167 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core HTTP clarification asking what response or status code applies when a server does not support conditional read, conditional create, conditional update, or conditional delete.

Later conformance cleanup standardized the unsupported conditional create/update/delete wording to SHOULD return HTTP 400 and MAY include OperationOutcome.
additional_context: source/http.html is the active RESTful API source page linked from source/documentation.html. Related combined-branch reconcile commits for FHIR-7926, FHIR-7927, and FHIR-7928 confirmed and corrected the optionality notes for conditional update/delete/create; later FHIR-16448 and FHIR-17256 changed conditional-operation maturity/conditional patch context without changing the unsupported-response guidance.
